map.怎么快速判断两色搭不搭？: How do I quickly judge whether two colours pair?
map.看色相环：相邻（类比）最稳、同色系最安全、互补最大胆；再考虑明度差，明暗拉得太开: Use the colour wheel: adjacent hues (analogous) are the steadiest, same-family colours are the safest and complements are the boldest. Then consider lightness — a very wide light-to-dark gap can look jarring.
